item.title: Own Your Intelligence: The Diffusion of AGI and the Skills You Keep
item.description: Everyone is watching the sky, but the thing they're watching for is already in the room — a folder of markdown files and a job that finishes while you sleep. The most valuable AI asset is not the model but the personal context and skills you build around it — the 'library and librarian' — which compounds and can be owned, not rented. Synthesized from IBM Technology, Matt Pocock, Y Combinator.
